provider.description: Provider token owning this event; MUST equal reference.provider.

labels.description: Adapter-normalized label names on the conversation (providers shape labels differently; normalization is the adapter's job). The kernel reads the flag, it never interprets labels.

sourceRefs.description: Inbound media attached to this message, already stored as kernel artifacts; carried verbatim into provider_events.body.

payload.description: Verbatim provider event payload as received by the adapter.
